name: Terminull Brigade™
description:
About This Game

Terminull Brigade is a co-op hero shooter set in futuristic digital worlds.

Rise in the virtual rebellion, solo or with others. Defeat enemies and take on bosses while following Aion’s lead to uncover Terminull’s secrets step by step.
short_desc: Rise with Aion — ignite the rebellion, slay the foes, rally your allies, and unmask Terminull’s deepest, most dangerous secrets before they can rewrite our world.
